Hackathon Duration: 36 Hours

  • 24 Hours → Coding & Development: Core building, prototyping, and implementation.
  • 6 Hours → Judging & Evaluation: Project submission, demos, and panel reviews.
  • 6 Hours → Breaks, Sessions & Chill: Fun activities, networking, sessions, and relaxation.

Get ready for one of the most exciting and intellectually stimulating hackathons of the year — CodeSlayer 2.0 2K26.

This national-level coding competition is designed to bring together India’s brightest student innovators to solve real-world challenges using technology, creativity, and collaboration.

CodeSlayer 2.0 is more than just a hackathon — it is a platform to create meaningful impact, win exciting rewards, showcase your skills, and build lasting connections with fellow innovators and the tech community.

Why Participate?

  • Big Challenges, Bigger Rewards: Work on real-world problems and propose innovative solutions.
  • Unparalleled Networking: Connect with developers, innovators, and tech enthusiasts from across India.
  • Career Growth: Build a strong portfolio and showcase your work to recruiters and tech communities.
  • Prizes and Recognition: Win exciting rewards, certificates, and swags.
  • Learn by Doing: Collaborate, innovate, and experience hands-on problem-solving in a competitive environment.

Eligibility

  • Open to B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, MCA, and students pursuing any Computer Science or related technology course..
  • Team size: 3–4 members.
  • Inter-college collaboration is encouraged.
  • Both beginners and experienced participants are welcome.

Structure

Round 1 – Online Ideation

  • Submit a PPT explaining your chosen problem statement, proposed solution, implementation approach, and expected impact.
  • A mandatory PPT template will be provided by the organiser on Unstop. All teams must prepare and submit their presentation using the provided template.
  • Submissions that do not follow the official PPT template will be rejected and will not be considered for evaluation.
  • Teams will be shortlisted based on the quality, feasibility, innovation, and potential of their proposed solution.

Round 2 – Offline Hackathon

Shortlisted teams will participate in the grand finale, where they will build and pitch their solutions on-site during the 36-hour hackathon.

Internet connectivity will be provided at the venue.

  • Grand Finale: 24–25 October 2026
  • Venue: TBD

Tracks

  • Healthcare
  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Web3 & Blockchain
  • Sustainability
  • Internet of Things (IoT)
  • Open Innovation

Rules & Guidelines

  • All core development must be completed during the offline hackathon.
  • Submissions must be original. Plagiarism will lead to disqualification.
  • Pre-built projects cannot be submitted as hackathon solutions.
  • Only shortlisted teams from Round 1 will qualify for Round 2.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • All participants must follow the official CodeSlayer 2.0 Rule Book and event guidelines.

Rule Book & Doubts: The official rule book and clarification link will be shared with participants.

Key Dates

  • Round 1 PPT Submission Deadline: 5 October 2026
  • Grand Finale (Round 2): 24–25 October 2026
  • Hackathon Duration: 36 Hours
  • Venue: TBD

Prizes & Recognition

  • Top 3 Winning Teams: Cash prizes, certificates, and exclusive goodies.
  • 5 Special Category Winning Teams: Each winning team will receive a cash prize, certificate, and special recognition under the following categories:
    • Best Web3 Team
    • Best Girls’ Team
    • Best AI/ML Team
    • Best IoT Team
    • Best Fresher Team
  • All Finalists: Certificates, swags, kits, and special takeaways.
  • Special Category Awards: Recognition for creativity, innovation, teamwork, and outstanding solutions.

  • Stay Connected:

    • WhatsApp Group: Join the official group for instant updates, team-building opportunities, and clarifications
      Join WhatsApp Group
    • LinkedIn: Follow for professional updates, partnerships, and to showcase your participation.
      https://www.linkedin.com/company/devsphereindia-community/
    • Instagram: Get behind-the-scenes updates, live highlights, and winner features.
      https://www.instagram.com/devsphereindia/

Pro Tip

Special announcements, surprise prize reveals, and important updates will be shared through the official WhatsApp group and social media channels.

Make sure you join and follow the official channels so you don’t miss any important updates.
